checks.why: a field holding an arrow, written as an element's event handler, is handed to the element: the component that renders it reaches what the handler calls
an inline arrow written as an attribute is handed over the same way
a tag that builds a class component hands the renderer its render and lifecycle methods: mounting it reaches what they call
…render included, so a test that mounts the component reaches the handlers its render hands out
a module function handed by name, and a render callback handed to a component, are reached from the function component that writes them
a module function handed by name to an intrinsic element
CONTROL: a class with a render method that no tag builds is not a component; constructing it does not run render
CONTROL: an attribute that is a call hands over what the call returns, not the function it calls; the call itself stays an ordinary resolved call
